title: Turn mode dial: fold Simultaneous into the mode dropdown + add Simultaneous per room

sections.what: Remove the separate Simultaneous Mode toggle and make the turn mode dropdown the single dial (Sequential / Random / Initiative / Simultaneous / Simultaneous per room). Add the frontend per-room variant: rooms resolve independently while characters inside a room act in order. Engine-level intent/effect and the per-room sync barrier stay with task-437/task-101.
sections.verify:
- expected: one turn-mode dial with 5 modes; no separate Simultaneous toggle.
- observed (2026-10-10 live): #agent-turn-order options = Sequential / Random / Initiative / Simultaneous / Simultaneous per room; no separate Simultaneous checkbox.
